title: Speaking — Trying unfamiliar technology
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on trying unfamiliar technology.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
Do you try new apps as soon as they appear?
Who helps you when you are using an unfamiliar device?

part2.topic: Describe a device or app you initially found difficult but now use confidently.
points: how you learned to use it
part2.closing: and explain why you continued rather than giving up.

questions: How should designers test whether a device is easy for first-time users?
Why do people sometimes refuse technology that could help them?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to trying unfamiliar technology?
